content: Generic ERP/inventory analytics SaaS table stakes: real-time-ish stock level tracking with automated low-stock/reorder alerts with customizable thresholds; ERP/CRM/accounting integration; core KPIs (inventory turnover, stockout rate, sell-through rate, reorder points, carrying cost, days of inventory on hand); multi-location/warehouse support; SKU-level detail with images and quantities; role-based access control.
